topics.title: Fairway Bunker Shots
topics.subtitle: Clean strikes from the sand
topics.defaultPrompt: Walk me through hitting a fairway bunker shot. What setup changes do I make, what swing changes, and how do I decide what club to use?
topics.promptTemplate: Walk me through fairway bunker shots — setup changes (ball position, weight, grip down), swing changes (steeper, ball-first), and club selection. {{skill_level_context}} {{detail_level_context}}

options.promptFragment: Include lip-height calculations, lie quality assessment, and how to play uneven sand lies.

options.promptFragment: Give me the highest-leverage adjustments.
